P02-002.reading: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים. Its clause runs to the verse end. It is carried by a 'he said to me' inside the vision. It is not a defined close-role formula (utterance, recognition, 'I YHWH have spoken', colophon, vision return); it is a refrain-grade transition by reading.
וַיָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗י: transport (class member) to the north gate, with a scene change (women weeping for Tammuz). The SAMEKH on 8:14 follows 8:14 and makes no face on this seam.

P02-002.face: onset seam far (8:6) - not asked; stated for symmetry
P02-002.reading: Ends וְעוֹד֙ תָּשׁ֣וּב תִּרְאֶ֔ה תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת, the same transition refrain, verse-final. SAMEKH (no face).

P02-005.reading: וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה: 'Then I looked, and behold', a sight-report opener introducing a new tableau (the sapphire throne-likeness over the cherubim). No onset-class device (no word-event, dateline, hand, transport, 'he said to me', messenger). A scene turn inside a continuing vision by reading.

Ends עָשִׂ֕יתִי כאשר צִוִּיתָֽנִי, the linen-clad man's report 'I have done as you have commanded me': a narrative completion of the ch-9 commission, with no close-role formula. SAMEKH (no face). K/Q and an OSHB vowel note at 9:11 (single witness).
'The form of a man's hand appeared ... under their wings': a descriptive aside after the fire-taking of 10:7. No close-role formula; at most a weak narrative pause.
וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה אוֹפַנִּים: the same 'I looked, and behold' opener as 10:1, turning to the wheel description. A scene/description turn by reading; no onset-class device.

P02-008.face: close seam near (11:13) - the view's census-absence question
P02-008.reading: Pelatiah dies as the prophet prophesies; the prophet falls on his face and cries 'Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?'. A narrative close with the prophet's intercessory cry (the same cry-shape as 9:8). No utterance, recognition or 'I YHWH have spoken' formula, no colophon, no vision return. The PE makes no face. The signal a reader finds is a narrative climax/discourse turn, not a defined close-role formula.
וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר: strict word-event, licensed.

P02-008.face: rival 11:4/11:5 near (11:5) - the view says onset side 'none'; the bytes carry more
P02-008.reading: וַתִּפֹּ֣ל עָלַי֮ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י אֱמֹר֙ כֹּה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כֵּ֥ן אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל: the Spirit falls on the prophet, 'he said to me' inside the vision, and a SHORT messenger formula כה אמר יהוה (the inventory's short-form census lists MT 11:5). By reading the speech addresses 'house of Israel' by name, while 11:2-4 speak about the twenty-five men in the third person. Whether that is an addressee change or the men addressed as Israel is a reading question.
לָכֵ֖ן הִנָּבֵ֣א עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם הִנָּבֵ֖א בֶּן אָדָֽם: a command to prophesy, with no close-role formula. The far face carries no signal.
P02-008.tier: READ (bytes not quoted beyond the ending; class: son-of-man only)

P02-011.reading: וָאַ֣עַשׂ כֵּן֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צֻוֵּיתִי֒: 'I did so as I was commanded', the prophet's compliance/execution report that completes the sign-act commanded in 12:3-6 and runs to the verse end ('... bore it on my shoulder in their sight'). A narrative close of the sign-act by reading. Not a defined close-role formula (no utterance, recognition, 'I YHWH have spoken', colophon or vision return). The PE makes no face.
וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י בַּבֹּ֥קֶר לֵאמֹֽר: word-event with the infixed 'in the morning' (vayehi-any list), plus a time shift to the next morning.

P02-019.reading: וַיָּב֤וֹא אֵלַי֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִזִּקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ לְפָנָֽי: a scene change. New participants (elders of Israel) come and sit before the prophet, the narrative setting the oracle of 14:2-11 answers. No onset-class device; the licensed word-event stands one verse later (14:2). The PE on 14:1 makes no face.
Ends וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה: the 2fp recognition refrain, verse-final (inventory 2fp and 64 lists). A close-role signal. No mark on 13:23.

P02-019.face: interior rival 14:1/14:2 (weighed in the SRA; absent from the view)
P02-019.reading: Near 14:2 is a strict word-event (licensed). Far 14:1 ends on narrative with no close-role signal. LICENSED, not two-faced; held on the over-split guard and the scene-setting ground.

P03-007.reading: הִנֵּה֙ כָּל הַמֹּשֵׁ֔ל עָלַ֥יִךְ יִמְשֹׁ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּאִמָּ֖ה בִּתָּֽהּ: a הנה-introduced proverb citation (mashal root) that turns the discourse from the judgment of 16:35-43 to the mother-and-sisters comparison. It is not a command to the prophet to speak a mashal, and no counted onset device stands here. A discourse turn without formula.

The utterance formula נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה is followed within the verse by וְלֹ֤א עשיתי אֶת הַזִּמָּ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִךְ, a finite clause with its own verb (ketiv עשיתי / qere עָשִׂית). By the letter of the dependent-completion test it is an independent clause, so the formula is mid-verse. A reader can take the clause as part of the יען complaint, which leaves the formula embedded. Mid-verse by the letter.
'They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it': the verdict ending the Sodom comparison, a content close with no formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.

וְשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן כַּחֲצִ֥י חַטֹּאתַ֖יִךְ: the comparison moves from Sodom to Samaria, a sister already named at 16:46. Same addressee (Jerusalem, 2fs), no onset device. A topical step inside the sisters comparison, not a discourse onset.

The rival the token stands for is the forward merge 16:44-16:58. Its disputed seam is the row's own close seam 16:50/16:51, and 16:51 is that seam's far face, so no interior-rival pair exists for it. A reader pairing it would write 16.50/16.51 and would be describing the own close seam, not a rival.

P03-012.reading: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֮ חַי אָנִי֒: a לכן + messenger + oath opener. Addressee: 17:12 opens the interpretation 'say now to the rebellious house' (אֱמָר נָא֙ לְבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֔רִי), 17:12-18 speak of the king in the third person, and 17:19 keeps the king in the third person ('my oath that he has despised'). No addressee change by reading. The signal is a discourse turn from indictment to a sworn verdict introduced by לכן, the routed לכן-turn class.
Ends לֹ֥א יִמָּלֵֽט ('He won't escape'), a verdict clause and not a defined close-role formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.

The alternative it stands for is the forward merge 17:19-24. Its disputed seam is the row's own close seam 17:21/17:22, which is two-faced: near 17:21 ends verse-final on 'you shall know that I YHWH have spoken', far 17:22 opens a fresh messenger formula after that close. No interior pair exists; a pair would name the own close seam.

P03-015.reading: וְאִ֖ישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק: the protasis of a new case ('if a man is righteous'), a casuistic case turn with no onset-class device. A discourse turn without formula.

Ends הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֥יא תָמֽוּת ('The soul who sins, he shall die'), the thesis sentence answering the proverb of 18:2-3. A thesis close by reading, not a defined close-role formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.

The alternative is the fusion of 18:5-9 with 18:10-20. Its disputed seam is the own close seam 18:9/18:10: near 18:9 is verse-final on נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה (licensed close-role); far 18:10 continues the casuistry with a new sub-case (וְהוֹלִ֥יד בֵּן פָּרִ֖יץ) and no onset device. No interior pair exists.

P03-018.reading: וּבְשׁ֨וּב צַדִּ֤יק מִצִּדְקָתוֹ֙ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֔וֶל: the protasis of the reverse case (the righteous man who turns to iniquity). A casuistic case turn with no onset-class device.

הֶחָפֹ֤ץ אֶחְפֹּץ֙ מ֣וֹת רָשָׁ֔ע נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֲל֛וֹא בְּשׁוּב֥וֹ מִדְּרָכָ֖יו וְחָיָֽה: the utterance formula stands between the two members of a disjunctive rhetorical question (הֶחָפֹ֤ץ ... הֲל֛וֹא ...). The words after it are the second member, with its own verb. They are not a temporal infinitive, adverbial or relative, so not a listed dependent completion, yet they complete the question the formula interrupts. Mid-verse by the letter; the question sentence runs to the silluq. UNDETERMINED between the two shapes the refinement names. The SAMEKH makes no face.
Ends בְּעַוְל֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה יָמֽוּת: restatement of the reverse case's verdict ('in his iniquity that he has done he shall die'). A verdict close with no formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.
וּבְשׁ֣וּב רָשָׁ֗ע מֵֽרִשְׁעָתוֹ֙: the protasis of the positive case (the wicked man who turns), a case turn with no onset-class device.

P04-005.face: close seam near (MT 21:5 = WEB 20:49) - census-absence question
P04-005.reading: וָאֹמַ֕ר אֲהָ֖הּ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הֵ֚מָּה אֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֔י הֲלֹ֛א מְמַשֵּׁ֥ל מְשָׁלִ֖ים הֽוּא: the prophet's reply ends the divine speech and labels what precedes as mashal ('Is he not a maker of parables?'). A signal the census does not list: a genre colophon (self-labelling of the parable) plus a discourse turn from divine speech to the prophet's complaint, verse-final. Whether this counts as the 'genre colophon' of the close-role definition is a reader judgement. The PE makes no face.

P04-011.reading: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם הִנָּבֵ֤א וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה אֶל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן: the oracle is directed to/concerning the children of Ammon. The preceding stretch addresses the prince of Israel in the second person (MT 21:30 וְאַתָּה֙ חָלָ֣ל רָשָׁ֔ע נְשִׂ֖יא יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל). Addressee change by reading: YES, from the wicked prince of Israel to Ammon, a foreign nation.
P04-011.tier: MEASURED (bytes; son-of-man and messenger classes) + READ

P04-011.reading: Ends עַד בֹּ֛א אֲשֶׁר ל֥וֹ הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט וּנְתַתִּֽיו ('until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it'), a verdict cadence closing the prince oracle. No defined close-role formula; the PE makes no face.

P05-003.reading: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שָׁפַ֥כְתִּי חֲמָתִ֖י עֲלֵיכֶֽם: the words after כי אני יהוה are the predicate of the כי-clause ('that I, YHWH, have poured out my wrath on you'), as the WEB's single sentence also shows. A dependent completion of the formula's own clause, running to the silluq, so verse-final in effect by reading (the 7:9 מַכֶּֽה shape). The PE makes no face.

וּנְבִיאֶ֗יהָ טָח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ תָּפֵ֔ל ... אֹמְרִ֗ים כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דִבֵּֽר: the messenger formula is quoted speech of the false prophets inside a third-person indictment, not a divine messenger onset. Addressee unchanged: the land addressed at 22:24 (אֱמָר לָ֕הּ). No addressee change by reading.
Ends לְמַ֖עַן בְּצֹ֥עַ בָּֽצַע (the officials 'to get dishonest gain'), a list item in the indictment with no close-role signal.

P05-006.reading: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶֽת אָהֳלָ֖ה וְאֶת אָהֳלִיבָ֑ה: YHWH turns to address the prophet and commissions judgment of BOTH sisters. The preceding oracle (23:22-35) addresses Oholibah in the 2fs. Addressee change by reading: YES, from Oholibah to the prophet, with both sisters as objects (and a 2fp address at the close, 23:48-49).

Opens with a messenger formula, but ENDS וְגַם אַ֛תְּ שְׂאִ֥י זִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְאֶת תַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ ('bear your lewdness and your prostitution'), a verdict clause with no close-role formula. By the own-seam definition (far face carries a signal when it ends on a close-role signal) this face carries none; the view's 'licensed messenger formula' describes its opening, not its end. The SAMEKH makes no face. The verse before it, 23:34, ends verse-final on כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה.

P06-004.reading: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּתִתִּ֥י אֶת נִקְמָתִ֖י בָּֽם: after the formula comes only בְּתִתִּ֥י ..., a be + infinitive construct temporal clause ('when I lay my vengeance on them') dependent on וידעו. That is the dependent-completion shape the refinement names (the 36:23 shape), so verse-final in effect by reading. The SAMEKH makes no face.

P06-011.reading: Ends בַּלָּה֣וֹת הָיִ֔יתָ וְאֵינְךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָֽם ('You have become a terror, and you will exist no more'). A signal the census does not list: the Tyre-dirge refrain. The skeleton בלהות stands in exactly three verses, 26:21, 27:36 and 28:19, each the final verse of a Tyre oracle/lament, with ואינך in all three. Verse-final by position; a refrain close by reading, not a defined close-role formula. The PE makes no face.

P07-001.reading: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה ends at the etnachta; the second half is יַ֧עַן אָמַ֛ר יְאֹ֥ר לִ֖י וַאֲנִ֥י עָשִֽׂיתִי, an independent causal clause with finite verbs. This is the weak mid-verse shape the refinement names by this very verse, so the refinement does not lift it.
P07-001.tier: MEASURED (bytes) + READ (syntax; matches the controlling agent's own reading)

P07-001.reading: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְאֶל יְאֹרֶ֑יךָ: a לכן + הנני אליך verdict opener restating the charge against Pharaoh. Not an inventoried class, but the verdict-onset material the far-face-empty test says to read. The far face is not empty by reading.

P07-001.face: onset far (28:26) - the view's strict test marks it mid-verse
P07-001.reading: Ends וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם: the only word after the divine name is אלהיהם, an apposition that belongs to the formula itself (the inventory records this 'their God' extension on 28:26, 34:30, 39:28). Verse-final in effect by reading. The SAMEKH makes no face.

לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלַ֖יִךְ חָ֑רֶב: the addressee is 2fs (עָלַ֖יִךְ, מִמֵּ֖ךְ, the land of Egypt), where 29:6-7 address a 2ms (בְּךָ֤, עָלֶ֨יךָ֙, Egypt/Pharaoh as the reed staff). Addressee change by reading: YES, a grammatical and referential shift.
Ends וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ֥ לָהֶ֖ם כָּל מָתְנָֽיִם, the end of the broken-staff image, with no close-role formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.

P08-005.reading: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם בְּנֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ הַנִּדְבָּרִ֤ים בְּךָ֙: ve'attah + son of man. The speech turns to the prophet himself about his audience. In 33:23-29 the prophet carries a message to the inhabitants of the ruins ('say thus to them', MT 33:27 כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֨ר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם), who are addressed in the message. Addressee change by reading: YES, from the land-claimants to the prophet, with the topic turning to how the people hear him.

P08-005.face: onset far (33:29) - strict test marks it mid-verse
P08-005.reading: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּתִתִּ֤י אֶת הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּמְשַׁמָּ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל תּוֹעֲבֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ: after the formula come a be + infinitive temporal clause and a relative clause, the dependent completions the refinement names. Verse-final in effect by reading. The SAMEKH makes no face.

וּבְבֹאָ֑הּ הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֔ה וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י נָבִ֖יא הָיָ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽם: a verse-final knowledge clause of recognition shape with 'a prophet' in place of 'I am YHWH'. Its skeleton כי נביא היה בתוכם stands only at MT 2:5 and 33:33, so it echoes the commission refrain. A refrain-grade close by reading, not a counted class. The SAMEKH makes no face.

P08-002.reading: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֗ם אֱמֹר֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל: ve'attah + son of man with a message for the house of Israel. The verses before (MT 33:7-9, וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם צֹפֶ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל) are the watchman charge spoken TO the prophet about his duty. Addressee change by reading: YES, from the prophet's own charge to a message for the house of Israel. (33:2-6, before that, had also addressed the people, so the chapter alternates.)

Ends וְאַתָּ֖ה נַפְשְׁךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ ('but you have delivered your soul'), the closing clause of the watchman case (the same close as 3:19/3:21 by reading). Not a defined close-role formula. The SAMEKH makes no face.

וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י אִ֧ישׁ כִּדְרָכָ֛יו אֶשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶתְכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: the people's complaint repeated, then the divine verdict with a vocative.
